name: OK-98 blaster carbine
description: The OK-98 blaster carbine was a type of blaster carbine manufactured by SoroSuub Corporation. It featured twin power packs that doubled the carbine's ammunition capacity. Although it was known to perform adequately, the OK-98 sold poorly, so despite its large production run, the blaster carbine was discontinued by SoroSuub and they were auctioned off.
